part.title: Quantization Algorithms, Formats, Kernels, and Inference Systems
part.readme_note: The v1.0 baseline has four modules and 14 units, with a Quantized Model Passport for every experiment. Start with CPU matrices, then a few layers, then Qwen3-8B W4A16 G128. CNN/MQBench is a classic side track. See the [Part 9 design](docs/chapters/part-09-quantization/design.md).

9.1.title: Quantization systems and terminology
9.1.topics: Separate algorithms, schemes, representations, formats, layouts, and kernels; affine Q/DQ/requantization with zero-points, repacking, a hand-computed Linear, and evidence-aware passports

9.2.title: Numerical representations, quantization formulas, and tensor contracts
9.2.topics: Integer and floating-point representations; affine grouped Q/DQ, axes, tails and scale precision; MX/NV block scales and effective bits per weight

9.3.title: Calibration, observers, and error measurement
9.3.topics: Reproducible calibration protocols, valid tokens/masks and held-out evaluation; MinMax/EMA/histogram/percentile/MSE search; weight, layer, block and task objectives with explicit input provenance

9.4.title: Quantization algorithms and error control
9.4.topics: RTN, clipping and rounding objectives; GPTQ Hessian, compensation, Cholesky, damping and groups; AWQ-inspired scaling, rotation, FakeQuant/STE and PTQ/QAT

9.5.title: Activation quantization and mixed-precision strategies
9.5.topics: Static/dynamic activation scales, token/block granularity, outliers and transforms, sensitivity, and precision allocation under quality or memory budgets

9.6.title: Quantization frameworks, export workflows, and ecosystem
9.6.topics: Teaching roles for MQBench/PPQ, LightCompress, AutoRound, LLM Compressor, and ModelOpt; independent export paths and algorithm/format separation

9.7.title: Checkpoint formats and the quantized weight ABI
9.7.topics: GPTQ/AWQ/compressed-tensors/GGUF; weight, zero-point, scale and group metadata; container, storage, and execution contracts

9.8.title: Bit packing, serialization, and repacking
9.8.topics: INT4 byte/word packing; bit-stream, padded, and block-word alternatives; serialization, repacking and inverses, endianness, and tails

9.9.title: Weight-only GEMV/GEMM and tuning
9.9.topics: Explicit versus fused dequantization, actual compute types, prefill/decode shape sweeps, tiling, reuse, pipelines, registers, split-K, and tuning

9.10.title: Activation quantization, low-precision GEMM, and fusion
9.10.topics: Start with INT8 W8A8; conditional FP8/W4A8/FP4 paths; time statistics, Q, GEMM, scaling, DQ, and epilogues; fusion ablations

9.11.title: KV cache quantization and attention integration
9.11.topics: Quantized writes, cache and scale lifetimes, dequantized reads, granularity, KV formats, algorithm cases, and long-context quality

9.12.title: MoE, parallel sharding, and quantization
9.12.topics: TP sharding and group boundaries, fused QKV, expert sensitivity and imbalance, grouped computation, and EP metadata/communication

9.13.title: Integrating quantization into vLLM
9.13.topics: Trace configuration, method selection, weight creation/loading, post-load processing, repacking, backend dispatch, and fallback in pinned vLLM source

9.14.title: From kernel gains to end-to-end inference acceleration
9.14.topics: Numerical correctness, model quality, kernel/model/serving measurements, memory, latency, throughput, goodput, amortization, and independent platform reports
